reasons: Classification is correct: the grant in p0030 runs only to Licensee and p0045/p0041 affirmatively confine use to Licensee's employees with third-party access only by discretionary Licensor consent, so there is no notice-based path to add Affiliates — the clause fails the fallback (affiliates on written notice) on a material term rather than merely falling short of preferred wording.

Redline is valid and minimal: it inserts 'its Affiliates and its contractors acting on Licensee's behalf' into the grant and conforms the employee-only access restriction in p0045, using the existing defined term 'Affiliates' (1.1) and leaving Field of Use and other restrictions intact.

No double-flagging: revocability/no-cure termination is expressly deferred to the termination rule, and successor transfer is correctly treated as near-fallback via p0149 read with the Change of Control section and left un-redlined.
Comment matches the edit, cites the playbook position in one or two sentences, offers the written-notice fallback, and uses the required prefix and first-person plural tone.

Minor residual note (not disqualifying): p0041 still bars disclosure to 'any third party ... without the prior written consent of Licensor', which a strict reader could invoke against Affiliates/contractors; consider a short carve-out ('other than Licensee's Affiliates and contractors acting on its behalf') to fully align that restriction with the expanded grant.
